nodes.description: Private constant-like upper bound on valid color token IDs, set to 2**24, used in tokenId range checks.
Private state variable holding the last generated pseudo-random token id, updated by nextTokenId.
Public mint price in wei (0.01 ether), compared against msg.value in mintHex.
Bytes constant-like hex alphabet '0123456789ABCDEF' used to build alphabetMap in the constructor.
Mapping from hex character byte to its numeric value, read by hexToDec.
Private owner address inherited from Ownable, read by owner() and written by _setOwner.
ReentrancyGuard status flag compared and written by the nonReentrant modifier.
Color constructor: initializes ERC721 name/symbol, sets lastTokenId to 0 and fills alphabetMap.
External payable mint that takes a hex string, checks publicPrice against msg.value and mints the decoded token id.
External mint that derives a token id from nextTokenId until an unused id is found, then claims it.
Owner-restricted and nonReentrant function minting an arbitrary valid token id to the owner.
Pure override that builds a base64-encoded JSON/SVG data URI for a color token id.
Internal view that converts a 6-character hex string into the corresponding decimal token id using alphabetMap and bit shifts.
Internal nonReentrant function that range-checks a token id and safely mints it to _msgSender().
Internal function implementing a linear congruential generator to produce the next pseudo-random token id.
Inherited ERC721 internal that mints a token and checks the receiver via _checkOnERC721Received.
Inherited ERC721 internal that performs the actual balance/owner bookkeeping for a new token.
Inherited ERC721 private helper that makes an external call to the receiver contract on safe transfers.
Context internal function returning msg.sender, used as the trusted caller accessor.
Ownable view returning the current _owner address.
Ownable modifier requiring owner() == _msgSender(), used as the access-control gate.
ReentrancyGuard modifier that checks and toggles _status around the guarded function body.
Ownable private function that swaps the owner address and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Ownable onlyOwner function transferring ownership to a new non-zero address.
Ownable onlyOwner function that sets the owner to address(0).
External caller address (msg.sender) flowing through _msgSender into mint/claim and access-control checks.
External callback to IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received performed during _safeMint, giving the receiver control flow.
Arithmetic in nextTokenId: lastTokenId = (a * lastTokenId + c) % m, a modular pseudo-random computation.
Arithmetic in hexToDec: res += alphabetMap[strBytes[i]] << (4*(5-i)), combining mapping lookups and shifts.
Payment handling in mintHex: require(publicPrice <= msg.value) validating the sent ether amount.
hexStr string parameter of mintHex, forwarded to hexToDec.
tokenId parameter of ownerClaim, range-checked and minted to the owner.
tokenId parameter of tokenURI used to render the color metadata.
hexStr string parameter of hexToDec, indexed byte by byte.
tokenId parameter of claimById, validated against maxColor before minting.
newOwner address parameter of transferOwnership, checked non-zero and stored.
Local tokenId in mintHex holding the result of hexToDec before claimById.
Local tokenId in mint holding the value returned by nextTokenId.
Local accumulator res in hexToDec that holds the decoded decimal value.
Local hexColor string produced by Strings.toHexString inside tokenURI.
Local colorBox SVG string concatenated inside tokenURI.
Local json base64 metadata string built inside tokenURI.
Local oldOwner in _setOwner temporarily caching the previous owner before the swap.

edges.reason: Color constructor chain invokes Ownable constructor which calls _setOwner to initialize ownership.
Constructor initializes lastTokenId to 0.
Constructor writes alphabetMap entries from the alphabet bytes.
alphabet bytes are read to populate alphabetMap in the constructor.
Constructor path reaches _msgSender through the Ownable constructor.
_msgSender returns the untrusted caller msg.sender.
mintHex calls hexToDec to convert the supplied hex string into a token id.
The hexStr parameter of mintHex flows into hexToDec.
mintHex enforces the payment requirement through the msg.value check.
publicPrice is compared against msg.value in the mintHex payment check.
The value returned by hexToDec is stored in the local tokenId of mintHex.
The decoded tokenId local is passed to claimById for minting.
mintHex calls claimById to perform the actual safe mint.
mint repeatedly calls nextTokenId to derive a candidate token id.
The value returned by nextTokenId is assigned to the local tokenId in mint.
mint stores and updates its local tokenId loop variable.
mint calls claimById once an unused token id is found.
The loop-derived tokenId local is passed into claimById.
ownerClaim is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier before any minting occurs.
onlyOwner calls owner() to fetch the privileged address.
onlyOwner calls _msgSender() to obtain the caller being authorized.
ownerClaim body executes under the nonReentrant guard.
ownerClaim performs a safe mint, which triggers receiver callbacks and re-entrancy surface.
The tokenId parameter of ownerClaim is used for the mint.
owner() result is passed as the recipient to _safeMint in ownerClaim.
maxColor bounds the tokenId validity check in ownerClaim.
The tokenId parameter drives the metadata rendered by tokenURI.
tokenURI derives the hexColor local from the token id.
hexColor is embedded into the colorBox SVG local.
colorBox is base64-encoded into the json metadata local.
hexToDec indexes into the hexStr parameter to decode characters.
hexToDec performs shift/index arithmetic while decoding each hex nibble.
alphabetMap values feed the arithmetic accumulation in hexToDec.
The arithmetic result is accumulated into the local res of hexToDec.
claimById is protected by the nonReentrant guard.
The tokenId parameter of claimById is validated and minted.
claimById calls _safeMint, exposing the external receiver callback path.
maxColor is the upper bound in the claimById range requirement.
lastTokenId is read as the seed of the LCG arithmetic in nextTokenId.
nextTokenId computes the modular multiplication and addition for the next id.
The arithmetic result is written back into lastTokenId.
_safeMint delegates the actual minting to _mint.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received to validate the receiving contract.
_checkOnERC721Received externally invokes onERC721Received on the receiver, enabling reentrant callbacks.
_checkOnERC721Received uses _msgSender as the operator argument of the callback.
The nonReentrant modifier reads and writes the _status guard variable.
transferOwnership is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
The newOwner parameter flows into the ownership transfer.
transferOwnership calls _setOwner to persist the new owner.
_setOwner writes the new address into the _owner state variable.
_setOwner caches the previous owner in the oldOwner local.
The cached oldOwner is read from _owner before the swap.
renounceOwnership is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership calls _setOwner(address(0)) to clear ownership.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: hexStr is the external input parameter of mintHex and should be normalized into that entry function.
tokenId is the sole parameter of ownerClaim and belongs to that function.
tokenId is the parameter of tokenURI used only to render metadata.
hexStr is the local decoding input of hexToDec and should collapse into it.
tokenId is the mint target parameter of claimById.
newOwner is the argument of transferOwnership and merges into it.
Local tokenId is a temporary result inside mintHex.
Local tokenId is the loop variable within mint.
res is the accumulator produced directly by the hexToDec arithmetic operation.
hexColor is an intermediate string local inside tokenURI.
colorBox is an intermediate SVG string local inside tokenURI.
json is the final intermediate local inside tokenURI.
oldOwner is a transient cache inside _setOwner and merges into that function.
